name: ⚔️Build to Defend Loot
desc:
🛠️ Build to Defend Loot! ⚔️

📌Please report any bugs!
Build your base, defend your loot, and steal from other players to reach the top! 💰🛡️

🔥 Features:
👍 Build and upgrade your base
🛒 Buy valuable loot
🏃 Steal other players’ loot
💸 Earn money even while offline
🛡️ Defend your base from attackers
⚔️ Buy gear to become stronger

📱 Supports Desktop, Mobile & Tablet

👥 Like the game and join the group for future updates! Click follow too for exclusive update notifications!
